primitives.name: Legal Data Coverage Gap
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{legal}': 'dimensionless, fraction of legally usable data', 'C_{seeded}': 'dimensionless, fraction of seeded source universe'}
primitives.assumptions: Coverage functions are monotonic and bounded between 0 and 1; legal constraints reduce effective coverage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_legal < C_seeded, system enters critical audit mode.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies legal compliance shortfall via ratio of usable to total potential data.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of licensed vs. available data points

primitives.name: Trust Explanation Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{trust}': 'dimensionless, normalized trust score', 'C_{conflict}': 'dimensionless, conflict density index', 'M_{missing}': 'count, number of missing data entries'}
primitives.assumptions: User comprehension time is fixed; explanation quality is inversely proportional to complexity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_trust < threshold or C_conflict > threshold, UX triggers.

layer2.mapping: Maps trust and conflict metrics into UX narrative structure for rapid comprehension.
layer2.telemetry: User engagement time on trust panels

primitives.name: Licensed Data Dependency
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: licensed route, pressure, coverage, tracking, PFF-like grades, and trenches data need contracts or first-party charting.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_{data}': 'dimensionless, licensed data dependency factor', 'D_{contract}': 'boolean, contract availability status'}
primitives.assumptions: Data utility increases linearly with licensing; missing contracts imply zero utility.

layer2.mapping: Encodes licensing requirements as a functional dependency on data utility.
layer2.telemetry: Contract fulfillment rate per data type
